note: attack_events are reconstructed from cumulative per-bibite feeding-poll counters (poll interval ~117 ticks); victim ids are unavailable for non-fatal bites, so only killed deaths have victim identity. Values are game cumulative counters at the poll after the increase.
contact_interval_note: Derived from cumulative feeding-poll counters (poll resolution); duration_ticks_approx is the poll-tick span of consecutive contact-poll frames, while contact_ticks is the summed counter increase.
